userStories.title: Pointer transitions recover deterministically after roadmap advance
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want roadmap pointer transitions to recover deterministically so active milestone/PRD state never becomes contradictory after updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Pointer transition recovery checks cover key lifecycle edge paths
No contradictory roadmap state remains after transition updates
No regression in current milestone/current PRD semantics
researchTopics: Roadmap pointer transition paths for currentMilestone/currentPRD updates during PRD completion and activation
Existing tests/assertions for deterministic roadmap state and contradictory-state prevention
userStories.learnings: Pointer determinism must be guarded across three synchronized surfaces: current pointer fields, PRD status/completedAt, and lifecycle changelog sequence.
userStories.implementationNotes: Add deterministic tests that reject contradictory pointer/state combinations and validate lifecycle sequence contracts by PRD IDs.

userStories.title: Activation/closure lifecycle sequence remains auditable and stable
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want activation/closure changelog sequencing to remain deterministic and auditable so lifecycle events are machine-consumable without ambiguity.
acceptanceCriteria: Activation/closure ordering is auditable and stable under repeated updates
No regression in roadmap lifecycle semantics
researchTopics: Lifecycle changelog event ordering patterns for prd_completed/prd_activated/current_prd_updated
Deterministic assertion strategy for activation/closure sequence stability
userStories.learnings: Lifecycle guards are most stable when validated as ID-keyed transition windows (`prd_completed` -> `prd_activated` -> `current_prd_updated`) instead of global-history positional assertions.
userStories.implementationNotes: Add deterministic multi-window lifecycle tests that assert action order, PRD-ID linkage (`activated == current_prd_updated`), and monotonic per-window timestamps while preserving non-blocking decision semantics.
